description: Do one task inside your own conversation and keep only its summary. Op start marks the place, op end (with summary) replaces everything since the mark by one summary message; status lists open tasks. More: aos/me/do_task.md.

task.description: start: one sentence, what the task is for

summary.description: end (required): what you found or did and still need

keep_others.description: end: true = keep letters that came in during the task unfolded
